lines.zh: 我弹一下，红色的边抖一抖。
lines.en: I bounce and my red edge quivers.

lines.zh: 我从树影里跳出去，又跳回来。
lines.en: I bounce out of the tree's shade and back in.
My red stands out. I can't hide.
I work my way up the slope, hop by hop.

lines.zh: 我落在沙上，沾了一层土。
lines.en: I land on sand and pick up a coat of grit.
I hop the path where it's uneven.
I trip and roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我的身体先到，影子后到。
lines.en: My body lands before my shadow does.

lines.zh: 我一跳就压平一小片草。
lines.en: Each hop flattens a patch of grass.
I hop in time with your steps.

lines.zh: 我从石头上一路滑下来。
lines.en: I slide all the way down a rock.
I move sluggishly; my hops are short.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着草叶，甩不掉。
lines.en: Grass clings to me and I can't shake it off.

lines.zh: 我一跳，红影在墙上一闪。
lines.en: One hop and a red flash crosses the wall.
I stop in a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面挪了一小段。
lines.en: I ooze along the ground a short way.
I spread flat on the ground.
A little light comes through my red skin.
I swell and sink, very slowly.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁爬到我身上，陷住了。
lines.en: An ant climbed on and sank in.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，把蚂蚁放出来。
lines.en: I wobble and let the ant go.
The wet sheen on my surface shifts.

lines.zh: 我不动，看起来像块红布。
lines.en: Held still, I look like a scrap of red cloth.
The grass rustles and I perk up.

lines.zh: 我的边缘慢慢淌开一点。
lines.en: My edges creep outward a little.
The sun warms me through.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是在那。
lines.en: I do nothing. I'm simply here.
I draw myself into a round shape.

lines.zh: 你身上有好大一片影子。
lines.en: You cast a very large shadow.
I press to your feet and you don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，到你腰那儿。
lines.en: I bounce and reach your waist.
Don't stand there. I'd bump into you.
This red is easy to spot, isn't it.
I come closer, all tacky.
I've made your boots damp.

lines.zh: 我仰起来看你，眼睛在里面。
lines.en: I rear up to look, my eyes inside.
Hit me and I'll come apart for you.
I come here often.

lines.zh: 我瘪了一块，黏液球掉在沙上。
lines.en: I dented; a slimeball dropped on the sand.

lines.zh: 黏液从边上流回来，鼓得更高。
lines.en: Slime flows back from the edges and I swell higher.
A bit of me broke off and splashed the grass.
That cost me a size.
I retreat two hops for space.
There's a small hollow in me now.
I flatten to the ground and recover.

lines.zh: 疼不疼我说不清，只觉得散了。
lines.en: Pain's unclear to me. I only feel scattered.
My red has paled. I don't like it.
A few more and I won't hold together.
That thing is swinging in your hand.
I ooze a little closer. Just a little.
It smells sweet.
My body has opened up a bit.
Lower it and I can reach.
Hold steady or I'll miss.
I bounce and nearly have it.
This is better than grass.
I cling to your hand. Cold.
Fine. I'll wait right here.
You stepped down and flattened a patch of me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓回来，边上不齐。
lines.en: I swell back, edges uneven.

lines.zh: 我这一身红太显眼，藏不住。
lines.en: This red of mine is too bright to hide.
You shook your leg before I dropped.
That impact spread me out.
I slid behind you.
I flattened a little patch of grass.
I pull back and round myself again.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上留了一块红。
lines.en: There's a red smear on your armor.
No pain. I'm just a bit less.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得贴到了树皮上。
lines.en: You knocked me flat against the bark.

lines.zh: 我沿着树皮慢慢滑下来。
lines.en: I slide slowly down the bark.
Bits of grass still cling to my edges.
You stepped aside and I bounced back.
Two reds pressed together go redder.
My kind are common around here.
One touch and I know it's you.

lines.zh: 我们一起跳，草会倒一片。
lines.en: Hopping together, we'd flatten a field.
I know nothing else. I only wobble.
I'm soft. Crowding doesn't hurt.
Nights are cold. Press close.

lines.zh: 合起来，我们能跳得更远。
lines.en: Together we could hop further.
You hop once, then I hop once.
We won't make a fuss. Just stay like this.
I wrap it and let it sink.

lines.zh: 这东西在我身体里发亮。
lines.en: This thing glows inside me.
I swallow, then push it back out.
Too hard to wrap around.
I balance it on top and hop.
Whatever hits the ground is mine.
I've got something inside me now.
I digest it slowly.
A bit of gel. Keep it.
It's caught in the middle of me, rocking.

lines.zh: 红色的一团朝你转过来了。
lines.en: A red blob turns toward you.
One hop and my direction is set.
You're right where I'd land.
My red has tightened.
I keep watching you without blinking.
One step back from you, and I follow.
Open ground. Nothing stops me.
I count how many hops remain.
Done. You'll do.
I want the warmth off you.

lines.zh: 每一次弹跳，距离都在缩。
lines.en: Every bounce pulls the distance in.
You go right; I bounce right.
I flatten and prepare to spring.
You're at the wall. Nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我的影子一跳一跳地追。
lines.en: My shadow hops after you.
Your steps have gone uneven. I can hear.
I spring straight out of the grass.
One more hop and I'm there.
I draw myself as small as I go.
You give half a block, I bounce one.
I bump you and smear your leg.
Soft, but not light.
I press my whole self onto your foot.
Gel works into the seams of your armor.
I bounce off and stick again.

lines.zh: 你打我，我凹进去又鼓起来。
lines.en: You hit me; I dent and swell.
I hop onto the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一撞是我全部的重量。
lines.en: That bump was all the weight I have.
I spring in from your side.

lines.zh: 撞完我散了一点，又合上。
lines.en: After the hit I spread and join again.

lines.zh: 我从土里鼓出来，红红的。
lines.en: I swell up out of the soil, red.
First a dot, then round.
Loose soil here. Good for me.

lines.zh: 红史莱姆跳两下，地上一片。
lines.en: Two hops and red slime stains the ground.
One of my kind is nearby.
My red leaves marks on the grass.
I rise slowly into shape.
The sun makes my red shine.

lines.zh: 这一带有水，我留在这儿。
lines.en: There's water here. I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我在地面上摊开又收拢。
lines.en: I spread on the ground and pull together.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我表面硬了一层。
lines.en: Fire sets a hard skin on me.
I fall and spread across the ground.
In water I dissolve and can't gather.

lines.zh: 冲击把我打成一片红点。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into red flecks.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，洞留住了。
lines.en: An arrow goes through and the hole stays.

lines.zh: 那力量让我变硬，动不了。
lines.en: That force hardens me. I can't move.
Nothing to swallow, so I shrink bit by bit.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，红都白了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my red goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里我一直在落，没有地。
lines.en: In the void I just keep falling. No ground.
